key_insight: DnA replaces standard softmax attention with a denoising strategy that separates truly relevant image features from nearby but irrelevant ones. This makes attention in visual models cleaner and more class-focused, improving feature selection for perception tasks.
problem_solved: Standard softmax multihead attention can produce noisy attention maps that mix important and distracting features, which weakens visual recognition and other perception tasks.
method: Use a positive query to identify image features that belong to the target class.
Use a negative query to capture closely related but irrelevant features.
Project attention through a denoising step so the model emphasizes useful signals and suppresses noise.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, DnA offers a drop-in way to make attention mechanisms more robust and interpretable in vision models. It can improve performance where attention noise hurts feature discrimination, such as classification and other visual understanding tasks.
